Thrust Royale

10 players are dropped into a skyline of towers. Last one standing wins. Left stick runs, and pushing it down drops through a floor. Right stick aims and fires. Tap the yellow button to jump, hold it in the air for the jetpack, or hold it against a wall to wall run for a fraction of the fuel. Tap the green button to slide for a speed boost (finish a slide and stand back up before sliding again). Grab guns, health and throwables, and stay inside the closing zone. Tap the purple button to reload. Tap a throwable square at the bottom to ready it, then drag the right stick to aim (red line) and release to throw. Pick the medkit square and the right stick becomes a heal button. Stand on a pickup and tap its small square to take, replace or switch.

    Choose a mode

    Battle Royale10 players, a huge arena, closing zone. Last one standing wins. You get 10 seconds to tap the map and pick where you land.
    Duo RoyaleBattle Royale in teams of two: 5 duos, a huge arena, closing zone, you and a bot partner against 4 bot duos. When your health runs out you are knocked down instead of killed, and your partner can help you up. If you are killed, you drop a Revive Card: your partner must pick it up where you fell, then press REVIVE and a coffin rises out of the ground and you walk out of it. Last duo standing wins.
